text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, making sex discrimination virtually impossible to substantiate. While an all-male panel might reflect poor institutional diversity practices, it provides no evidence of bias against you based on sex. Raising this issue would likely appear combative and undermine your professional credibility.

Instead, follow up politely on your request for written feedback. The appointment suggests the panel prioritized management qualifications and broad leadership experience over your higher academic degree (PhD vs. master's). Focus your efforts on understanding how leadership competencies were scored and identifying specific areas to strengthen your profile for future head-of-laboratory vacancies.
